source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 22ης Νοεμβρίου — «Άγιος Θαδδαίος»

attestations.note: The life page `https://www.saint.gr/3069/saint.aspx` heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 22 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. None of the corpus's three Thaddeus folders is this man: `thaddeus-apostle-of-the-seventy` is kept on the Greek 21 August, `thaddeus-of-stepantsminda` on 7 May and `thaddeus-29-december` on the Romanian 29 December, and nothing in this notice makes him any of them. The display name takes the day. The page gives no year, no country and no emperor, so no `dates` object is proposed. No hymn. No asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου».
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (2 October 2026).
